# Feature: LiveAct drive bind to 3D Setup expand modal

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-25 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
While the 3D Setup expand modal is open and Tracking is on, LiveAct must drive the **modal** avatar mesh (morphs/head), not only the hidden editor-card runtime. Closing the modal restores drive to the card.

## Preconditions
- Character Editor with WebGL avatar loaded
- Face Mapping optional (anchors are overlay-only; drive uses LiveAct morph channels)
- Vite on project `devUrl` / port 3004

## Happy Path
- [ ] Setup modal open + Tracking on + expand runtime ready → `engine.bindOutput` uses expand `getLiveActAvatarOutput()`
- [ ] Webcam jaw/blink changes deform the **modal** face (not only PiP / Applied HUD)
- [ ] Setup modal closed + Tracking on → bind returns to editor-card output
- [ ] Tracking off → `bindOutput(null)` regardless of modal
- [ ] Deterministic check covers expand-open bind preference

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Modal open but expand runtime not ready yet → no dual-drive; bind waits or stays on card until expand ready, then switches once
- [ ] Modal close clears expand runtime ref / ready flag so card rebinds
- [ ] One LiveAct engine → at most one bound avatar output (no fan-out)

## Regression
- [ ] Face Overlay still samples expand camera when modal open (`da20779`)
- [ ] Face Mapping Speichern / face_anchors persist path unchanged
- [ ] Card-only tracking (modal closed) still drives card mesh

## Assumptions
- Single active drive target is intentional (composition: one consumer)

## Implementation Notes
- Files touched: `AvatarSurfaceViewer.tsx` (XOR bind), `AvatarPreviewExpandDialog.tsx` (parent-owned runtime ref + ready), `scripts/liveact-expand-drive-bind-check.mjs`, `scripts/test-gate.mjs`, acceptance
- Unit tests: deterministic `liveact-expand-drive-bind-check`
- Drive: `previewExpandOpen && expandRuntimeReady` → expand output; else card; tracking off → null

## Composition Gate
- Producers: LiveAct engine frames
- Consumers: exactly one `LiveActAvatarOutput` (expand XOR card)
- Cardinality: one bind per tracking session state change
- Invalid/missing expand runtime: fail closed to card or null — never bind two outputs

## Security Coverage
- P-xx local-only LiveAct: no new network; webcam stays in existing engine path
- Out of scope: auth, uploads, secrets (editor UI bind switch only)
